brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished two residences belonging to members of the Kershan family and two sheep enclosures in the Waar al-Baik area of Anata village, northeast of occupied Jerusalem, the Ma'an news agency reported. The demolitions targeted structures in the rural section of the village.

Anata lies in the northern Jerusalem periphery and has experienced repeated demolition operations by Israeli authorities.
title: Israeli forces demolish homes and livestock shelters in occupied Jerusalem village
